device.description: 12-bit quad-channel ultralow-glitch voltage-output DAC with 50 MHz 3-wire SPI interface and single reference input (MSOP-10)
device.note: dac7554.pdf (SLAS399A) p.3 power requirements (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, logic levels 0.3/0.7 VDD), p.4 timing characteristics and serial write operation (Figure 1: LD1 LD0 SEL1 SEL0 D11-D0 on SCLK falling edges), p.5 pin description (DGS) and terminal functions, p.14 serial interface programming (Table 1), p.15 power-down mode control (Table 2), p.16 power-on reset (zero scale), 16-bit word, p.17 SYNC (data after the 16th SCLK falling edge ignored; SYNC high before it aborts)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: input register A; power-on reset clears it

registers.name: INB
registers.note: input register B; power-on reset clears it

registers.name: INC
registers.note: input register C; power-on reset clears it

registers.name: IND
registers.note: input register D; power-on reset clears it

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC register A; power-on reset clears it (zero scale)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC register B; power-on reset clears it (zero scale)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC register C; power-on reset clears it (zero scale)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC register D; power-on reset clears it (zero scale)

registers.name: PWR
registers.note: internal: per-channel power-down flag and DB8-DB7 mode from the last power-down command (Table 2: 00/11 Hi-Z, 01 1 kOhm, 10 100 kOhm)

commands.name: STORE
commands.note: Table 1 LD1 LD0 = 00: the selected input register (Sel1 Sel0 A-D)

commands.name: DAC UPDATE
commands.note: Table 1 LD = 01: the selected DAC register from its input register, output updated

commands.name: WRITE UPDATE
commands.note: Table 1 LD = 10: the selected input and DAC registers

commands.name: DAC UPDATE ALL
commands.note: Table 1 1101: DAC registers A-D, outputs updated

commands.name: WRITE UPDATE ALL
commands.note: Table 1 1110: input and DAC registers A-D

commands.name: PWD A
commands.note: Table 2: DB11 = 0, DB10-DB9 channel A, DB8-DB7 mode

commands.name: PWD B
commands.note: Table 2: DB11 = 0, DB10-DB9 channel B, DB8-DB7 mode

commands.name: PWD C
commands.note: Table 2: DB11 = 0, DB10-DB9 channel C, DB8-DB7 mode

commands.name: PWD D
commands.note: Table 2: DB11 = 0, DB10-DB9 channel D, DB8-DB7 mode

commands.name: PWD ALL
commands.note: Table 2: DB11 = 1 all channels, DB8-DB7 mode

pages: p.3 (supplies, logic levels), p.4 (timing, Figure 1), p.5 (pins), p.14 (Table 1), p.15 (Table 2), p.16-17 (power-on reset, serial interface)
notModeled: analog outputs and unbuffered REFIN reference (never driven)
power-down output loads: stored per channel in PWR only; how a powered-down channel returns to normal operation is not described
SCLK limits (50 MHz) and setup/hold times; 15 us power-up time
variants: quad member of the DAC7551/7552/7554/7558 family; no SDO, CLR or LDAC pins.
